nPC2.original:
N.P.C.2 reads the load order from Windows' own Plugins.txt (path shown below). Mod managers such as MO2 and Vortex redirect that file to the active profile's load order, but only for programs launched through them - otherwise the Skyrim launcher's own list is used instead.

Your appearance mods are still detected, since those are read directly from the Mods folder. What breaks is everything that depends on the load order: the output plugin will not be patched against the correct conflict winners, and NPCs from anything other than the base game and Creation Club will not appear in the NPCs menu.
nPC2.snippet:
Text="N.P.C.2 reads the load order from Windows' own Plugins.txt (path shown below). Mod managers such as MO2 and Vortex redirect that file to the active profile's load order, but only for programs launched through them - otherwise the Skyrim launcher's own list is used instead.

Your appearance mods are still detected, since those are read directly from the Mods folder. What breaks is everything that depends on the load order: the output plugin will not be patched against the correct conflict winners, and NPCs from anything other than the base game and Creation Club will not appear in the NPCs menu."

directoryWhereTheGenerated.snippet: Text="Directory where the generated plugin and related files will be saved."

appendDateTimeStamp.original: Append Date/Time Stamp to Output Directory
appendDateTimeStamp.snippet: Content="Append Date/Time Stamp to Output Directory"

ifCheckedATimestamp.original: If checked, a timestamp (YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS) will be appended to the Output Directory name upon generation.
ifCheckedATimestamp.snippet: ToolTip="If checked, a timestamp (YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS) will be appended to the Output Directory name upon generation."

determinesHowOverridenRecords.original: Determines how overriden records of other plugins are handled.
determinesHowOverridenRecords.snippet: ToolTip="Determines how overriden records of other plugins are handled."

howManyLayersDeep.original: How many layers deep to keep searching for overridden records between finding relevant ones. This is not a total depth limit — the count resets every time a record from the mod is found, so a continuous chain of the mod's records is always followed all the way down. Default is 2, which is what lets the search cross one unrelated record (e.g. a vanilla outfit) to reach the mod's edits below it. Higher values find more obscure overrides but take exponentially longer.
howManyLayersDeep.snippet: ToolTip="How many layers deep to keep searching for overridden records between finding relevant ones. This is not a total depth limit — the count resets every time a record from the mod is found, so a continuous chain of the mod's records is always followed all the way down. Default is 2, which is what lets the search cross one unrelated record (e.g. a vanilla outfit) to reach the mod's edits below it. Higher values find more obscure overrides but take exponentially longer."

ifChecked.original: If checked, grabs ALL override records from the plugins rather than searching by NPC dependencies. Use with caution.
ifChecked.snippet: ToolTip="If checked, grabs ALL override records from the plugins rather than searching by NPC dependencies. Use with caution."

generatesASkyPatcherIni.original: Generates a SkyPatcher .ini file for runtime patching instead of a traditional ESP. This is an advanced feature that may conflict with other runtime patchers.
generatesASkyPatcherIni.snippet: ToolTip="Generates a SkyPatcher .ini file for runtime patching instead of a traditional ESP. This is an advanced feature that may conflict with other runtime patchers."

whenWritingTheOutput.original: When writing the output plugin, checks if it can be ESLified and performs the ESLification proccess
whenWritingTheOutput.snippet: ToolTip="When writing the output plugin, checks if it can be ESLified and performs the ESLification proccess"

autoSplitIfOver.original: Auto-split if over the master limit
autoSplitIfOver.snippet: Content="Auto-split if over the master limit"

ifTheOutputPlugin.original: If the output plugin would exceed Skyrim's 255-master limit, automatically split it into multiple files (e.g. "MyPatch.esp", "MyPatch_2.esp", ...). Only triggers on overflow - a normal-sized patch stays a single plugin. When it does split, ALL of the resulting plugins must be enabled in your load order. Also applies per-plugin when 'Split Output' is on.
ifTheOutputPlugin.snippet: ToolTip="If the output plugin would exceed Skyrim's 255-master limit, automatically split it into multiple files (e.g. "MyPatch.esp", "MyPatch_2.esp", ...). Also applies per-plugin when 'Split Output' is on."

splitsTheGeneratedPatch.original: Splits the generated patch into multiple smaller plugins based on the criteria to the right.
splitsTheGeneratedPatch.snippet: ToolTip="Splits the generated patch into multiple smaller plugins based on the criteria to the right."

maximumNumberOfNPCs.original: Maximum number of NPCs to place in a single split plugin.
maximumNumberOfNPCs.snippet: ToolTip="Maximum number of NPCs to place in a single split plugin."

previewWornWigsThe.original: Preview worn wigs the way RaceMenu tints them
previewWornWigsThe.snippet: Content="Preview worn wigs the way RaceMenu tints them"

folderContainingSubfoldersFor.original: Folder containing subfolders for each mod's NPC preview images.
folderContainingSubfoldersFor.snippet: Text="Folder containing subfolders for each mod's NPC preview images."

dragToReorderDisabled.original: Drag to reorder. Disabled sources are skipped at runtime.
dragToReorderDisabled.snippet: Text="Drag to reorder. Disabled sources are skipped at runtime."

useFaceFinderAPIFor.original: Use FaceFinder API for missing mugshots
useFaceFinderAPIFor.snippet: Content="Use FaceFinder API for missing mugshots"

folderWhereFaceFinderDownloads.original: Folder where FaceFinder downloads are cached. Defaults to a 'FaceFinder Cache' folder next to the application.
folderWhereFaceFinderDownloads.snippet: ToolTip="Folder where FaceFinder downloads are cached. Defaults to a 'FaceFinder Cache' folder next to the application."

resetToTheDefault.original: Reset to the default FaceFinder cache folder.
resetToTheDefault.snippet: ToolTip="Reset to the default FaceFinder cache folder."

faceFinderDownloadsAreCached.original: FaceFinder downloads are cached here, in subfolders per mod.
faceFinderDownloadsAreCached.snippet: Text="FaceFinder downloads are cached here, in subfolders per mod."

ifCheckedImagesDownloaded.original: If checked, images downloaded from FaceFinder are saved and checked for updates. If unchecked, images are downloaded fresh every time.
ifCheckedImagesDownloaded.snippet: ToolTip="If checked, images downloaded from FaceFinder are saved and checked for updates. If unchecked, images are downloaded fresh every time."

writesAPITrafficTo.original: Writes API traffic to FaceFinderLog.html in the application directory (open it in any web browser). Each request is a collapsible entry with its status, headers, and full response body.
writesAPITrafficTo.snippet: ToolTip="Writes API traffic to FaceFinderLog.html in the application directory (open it in any web browser). Each request is a collapsible entry with its status, headers, and full response body."

manuallyLinkLocalMod.original: Manually link local mod names to their corresponding entry on the FaceFinder server.
manuallyLinkLocalMod.snippet: ToolTip="Manually link local mod names to their corresponding entry on the FaceFinder server."

iteratesEveryModS.original: Iterates every mod's NPCs and queries the FaceFinder API for an available mugshot. When image caching is on, hits are downloaded and persisted; when off, only availability is checked. Independent of the local-renderer 'Generate All Mugshots' batch — neither falls back to the other.
iteratesEveryModS.snippet: ToolTip="Iterates every mod's NPCs and queries the FaceFinder API for an available mugshot. permanentlyDeletesAllCached.original: Permanently deletes all cached FaceFinder images and their metadata files.
permanentlyDeletesAllCached.snippet: ToolTip="Permanently deletes all cached FaceFinder images and their metadata files."

fastUsesCachedList.original: Fast: Uses cached list of generated mugshots (recommended). Comprehensive: Scans all mugshot folders and reads metadata.
fastUsesCachedList.snippet: ToolTip="Fast: Uses cached list of generated mugshots (recommended). Comprehensive: Scans all mugshot folders and reads metadata."

folderWhereRenderedMugshots.original: Folder where rendered mugshots are saved. Defaults to an 'AutoGen Mugshots' folder next to the application.
folderWhereRenderedMugshots.snippet: ToolTip="Folder where rendered mugshots are saved. Defaults to an 'AutoGen Mugshots' folder next to the application."

resetToThe.original: Reset to the default auto-generated mugshots folder.
resetToThe.snippet: ToolTip="Reset to the default auto-generated mugshots folder."

internalLegacyRendererOutput.original: Internal/Legacy renderer output is saved here, in subfolders per mod.
internalLegacyRendererOutput.snippet: Text="Internal/Legacy renderer output is saved here, in subfolders per mod."

generatesAMugshotFor.original: Generates a mugshot for each local NPC that doesn't already have one, using the renderer selected above and the scope chosen in the dropdown to the right. NPCs are grouped by sex and shared NPC-record assets (race, worn armor, head parts, hair) so the renderer reuses meshes and textures across consecutive frames. FaceFinder downloads are handled separately via the FaceFinder section's 'Batch Download Mugshots' button.
generatesAMugshotFor.snippet: ToolTip="Generates a mugshot for each local NPC that doesn't already have one, using the renderer selected above and the scope chosen in the dropdown to the right. FaceFinder downloads are handled separately via the FaceFinder section's 'Batch Download Mugshots' button."

chooseWhichModTo.original: Choose which mod to generate mugshots for. 'All' processes every data-containing (non-mugshot-only) mod; selecting a specific mod limits the batch to that mod's NPCs.
chooseWhichModTo.snippet: ToolTip="Choose which mod to generate mugshots for. 'All' processes every data-containing (non-mugshot-only) mod; selecting a specific mod limits the batch to that mod's NPCs."

whenCheckedAnInternal.original: When checked, an Internal-renderer mugshot whose render reports any missing meshes or textures is skipped — no PNG is written — so the batch only persists complete renders. Uncheck to save the wireframe / placeholder-textured result anyway. Per-tile clicks ignore this toggle and always render.
whenCheckedAnInternal.snippet: ToolTip="When checked, an Internal-renderer mugshot whose render reports any missing meshes or textures is skipped — no PNG is written — so the batch only persists complete renders. Uncheck to save the wireframe / placeholder-textured result anyway. Per-tile clicks ignore this toggle and always render."

whenCheckedEveryInternal.original: When checked, every Internal-renderer load writes its full asset-resolution + renderer trace to <ExeDir>\RenderLogs\: live previews go to Preview_<ModName>_<FormKey>.txt, mugshot tile generations go to Mugshot_<ModName>_<FormKey>.txt. Use to diff a working preview against a tile that fails to render. Forces verbose logging on for the duration of the captured render.
whenCheckedEveryInternal.snippet: ToolTip="When checked, every Internal-renderer load writes its full asset-resolution + renderer trace to <ExeDir>\RenderLogs\: live previews go to Preview_<ModName>_<FormKey>.txt, mugshot tile generations go to Mugshot_<ModName>_<FormKey>.txt. Use to diff a working preview against a tile that fails to render. Forces verbose logging on for the duration of the captured render."

restoreInternalRendererSettings.original: Restore Internal-renderer settings to defaults. Preserves your saved lighting layouts / color schemes.
restoreInternalRendererSettings.snippet: ToolTip="Restore Internal-renderer settings to defaults. Preserves your saved lighting layouts / color schemes."

toggleTheLivePreview.original: Toggle the live preview viewport's visibility. Hide it to claw back vertical space when you're tweaking framing / asset-resolution settings without needing to see the rendered output.
toggleTheLivePreview.snippet: ToolTip="Toggle the live preview viewport's visibility. Hide it to claw back vertical space when you're tweaking framing / asset-resolution settings without needing to see the rendered output."

autoHairAwareFraming.original: Auto: hair-aware framing (head + hair-above-head). Manual: use the saved orbit camera state from the live preview.
autoHairAwareFraming.snippet: ToolTip="Auto: hair-aware framing (head + hair-above-head). Manual: use the saved orbit camera state from the live preview."

verticalPositionTheTOP.original: Vertical position the TOP of the head bounding box is mapped to, expressed as a fraction of the rendered frame height (1.0 = frame top edge, 0.0 = frame bottom edge). Examples: 0.95 leaves a 5% margin above the head top; 1.0 puts the head top exactly at the frame's top edge; values above 1.0 push the head top above the frame for an ultra-tight crop where the top of the head is clipped.
verticalPositionTheTOP.snippet: ToolTip="Vertical position the TOP of the head bounding box is mapped to, expressed as a fraction of the rendered frame height (1.0 = frame top edge, 0.0 = frame bottom edge). Examples: 0.95 leaves a 5% margin above the head top; 1.0 puts the head top exactly at the frame's top edge; values above 1.0 push the head top above the frame for an ultra-tight crop where the top of the head is clipped."

verticalPositionTheBOTTOM.original: Vertical position the BOTTOM of the head bounding box is mapped to, expressed as a fraction of the rendered frame height (1.0 = frame top edge, 0.0 = frame bottom edge). Examples: 0.10 leaves a 10% margin below the head bottom; 0.0 puts the head bottom exactly at the frame's bottom edge; negative values (e.g. -0.1) push the head bottom below the frame for an ultra-tight crop where the chin / neck is clipped. Values above the Frame Top setting are nonsensical (head bottom above head top).
verticalPositionTheBOTTOM.snippet: ToolTip="Vertical position the BOTTOM of the head bounding box is mapped to, expressed as a fraction of the rendered frame height (1.0 = frame top edge, 0.0 = frame bottom edge). Examples: 0.10 leaves a 10% margin below the head bottom; 0.0 puts the head bottom exactly at the frame's bottom edge; negative values (e.g. -0.1) push the head bottom below the frame for an ultra-tight crop where the chin / neck is clipped. Values above the Frame Top setting are nonsensical (head bottom above head top)."

verticalPositionThe.original: Vertical position the BOTTOM of the head bounding box is mapped to, expressed as a fraction of the rendered frame height (1.0 = frame top edge, 0.0 = frame bottom edge). Examples: 0.10 leaves a 10% margin below the head bottom; 0.0 puts the head bottom exactly at the frame's bottom edge; negative values (e.g. -0.1) push the head bottom below the frame for an ultra-tight crop where the chin / neck is clipped.
verticalPositionThe.snippet: ToolTip="Vertical position the BOTTOM of the head bounding box is mapped to, expressed as a fraction of the rendered frame height (1.0 = frame top edge, 0.0 = frame bottom edge). Examples: 0.10 leaves a 10% margin below the head bottom; 0.0 puts the head bottom exactly at the frame's bottom edge; negative values (e.g. -0.1) push the head bottom below the frame for an ultra-tight crop where the chin / neck is clipped."

cameraYawInDegrees.original: Camera yaw in degrees. 180 = facing camera.
cameraYawInDegrees.snippet: ToolTip="Camera yaw in degrees. 180 = facing camera."

howTheInProcess.original: How the in-process renderer sizes its decoded-texture and parsed-mesh RAM caches during mugshot generation. '% Free RAM' (default) grows the cache into a share of spare system memory; 'Fixed RAM' caps the total at the budget below; 'Disabled' turns caching off (renders decode fresh each time — slower, minimal RAM). Takes effect within a few renders; no restart needed.
howTheInProcess.snippet: ToolTip="How the in-process renderer sizes its decoded-texture and parsed-mesh RAM caches during mugshot generation. '% Free RAM' (default) grows the cache into a share of spare system memory; 'Fixed RAM' caps the total at the budget below; 'Disabled' turns caching off (renders decode fresh each time — slower, minimal RAM). Takes effect within a few renders; no restart needed."

totalShareOfFree.original: Total share of free RAM the decode caches may use together (they keep their fixed 75:9:1 ratio). 85 is the default; higher caches more aggressively, lower frees RAM for other work. Takes effect within a few renders; no restart needed.
totalShareOfFree.snippet: ToolTip="Total share of free RAM the decode caches may use together (they keep their fixed 75:9:1 ratio). 85 is the default; higher caches more aggressively, lower frees RAM for other work. Takes effect within a few renders; no restart needed."

totalShareOf.original: Total share of free RAM (0-100) the renderer's decode caches may collectively use in % Free RAM mode.
totalShareOf.snippet: ToolTip="Total share of free RAM (0-100) the renderer's decode caches may collectively use in % Free RAM mode."

approximateTotalRAMGB.original: Approximate total RAM (GB) the renderer's decode caches may use in Fixed RAM mode.
approximateTotalRAMGB.snippet: ToolTip="Approximate total RAM (GB) the renderer's decode caches may use in Fixed RAM mode."

includeHairBrowsMouth.original: Include hair / brows / mouth in framing
includeHairBrowsMouth.snippet: Content="Include hair / brows / mouth in framing"

whenEnabledHairAbove.original: When enabled, hair-above-head and other facial accessories help frame the shot - but floor-length braids are clipped at the head's lower bound so they don't blow out the frame.
whenEnabledHairAbove.snippet: ToolTip="When enabled, hair-above-head and other facial accessories help frame the shot - but floor-length braids are clipped at the head's lower bound so they don't blow out the frame."

whenOnDefaultA.original: When on (default), a loose copy of an asset under your Skyrim Data folder takes precedence over any BSA copy of the same path - including BSAs scoped to a non-vanilla mod. Mirrors the engine's actual rule that loose Data files override BSA-packed ones. Turn off for strict-BSA mode (preview the original mod content without your installed loose-file overrides).
whenOnDefaultA.snippet: ToolTip="When on (default), a loose copy of an asset under your Skyrim Data folder takes precedence over any BSA copy of the same path - including BSAs scoped to a non-vanilla mod. Mirrors the engine's actual rule that loose Data files override BSA-packed ones. Turn off for strict-BSA mode (preview the original mod content without your installed loose-file overrides)."

whenOnALoose.original: When on, a loose copy of an asset in your Skyrim Data folder takes precedence over the same path in any mod folder, letting your installed body / skin / texture replacers leak into mod-specific previews. FaceGen NIFs and FaceTint DDS are excluded so the mod's actual face overrides aren't replaced by vanilla copies. Off by default.
whenOnALoose.snippet: ToolTip="When on, a loose copy of an asset in your Skyrim Data folder takes precedence over the same path in any mod folder, letting your installed body / skin / texture replacers leak into mod-specific previews. FaceGen NIFs and FaceTint DDS are excluded so the mod's actual face overrides aren't replaced by vanilla copies. Off by default."

whenOnDefault.original: When on (default), a mugshot produced by an older version of the renderer (Internal) or the NPC Portrait Creator (Legacy) is treated as stale and re-rendered, so it picks up rendering fixes and improvements from the current version. Turn off to keep older-version mugshots in place.
whenOnDefault.snippet: ToolTip="When on (default), a mugshot produced by an older version of the renderer (Internal) or the NPC Portrait Creator (Legacy) is treated as stale and re-rendered, so it picks up rendering fixes and improvements from the current version. Turn off to keep older-version mugshots in place."

whenOn.original: When on (default), a mugshot is re-rendered when the settings it was generated with - lighting, camera / framing, background, resolution and render options - no longer match your current settings. Turn off to keep existing mugshots in place even after you change these settings.
whenOn.snippet: ToolTip="When on (default), a mugshot is re-rendered when the settings it was generated with - lighting, camera / framing, background, resolution and render options - no longer match your current settings. Turn off to keep existing mugshots in place even after you change these settings."

when.original: When on (default), a previously-generated mugshot whose stamped metadata records missing BASE NPC assets — the NPC's own head/body/hair meshes or textures, or a FaceGen mismatch — is treated as stale and re-rendered on the next session, giving newly-installed assets a chance to fill in the wireframe / placeholder areas automatically. Turn off to keep the existing PNG in place even when it depicts an incomplete model.
when.snippet: ToolTip="When on (default), a previously-generated mugshot whose stamped metadata records missing BASE NPC assets — the NPC's own head/body/hair meshes or textures, or a FaceGen mismatch — is treated as stale and re-rendered on the next session, giving newly-installed assets a chance to fill in the wireframe / placeholder areas automatically. Turn off to keep the existing PNG in place even when it depicts an incomplete model."

whenOnDefaultAMugshot2.original: When on (default), a mugshot whose stamped metadata records missing outfit/headgear meshes or textures is re-rendered on the next session so newly-installed attire assets fill in the wireframe / placeholder areas. (Broken outfit physics links are excluded: nothing you install can fix a stale link inside the mod.) Turn off to keep the existing PNG in place.
whenOnDefaultAMugshot2.snippet: ToolTip="When on (default), a mugshot whose stamped metadata records missing outfit/headgear meshes or textures is re-rendered on the next session so newly-installed attire assets fill in the wireframe / placeholder areas. (Broken outfit physics links are excluded: nothing you install can fix a stale link inside the mod.) Turn off to keep the existing PNG in place."

whenOnDefaultAMugshot3.original: When on (default), a mugshot rendered with missing meshes/textures (or a detected FaceGen mismatch) shows the missing-asset warning icon, and that state is recorded in the PNG so the icon survives restarts. Unchecking hides the icon and re-renders the affected mugshots once so their recorded state is cleared. Note: while off, newly-rendered mugshots record no missing assets, so the 'Re-render When: Missing Assets' option has nothing to act on for them.
whenOnDefaultAMugshot3.snippet: ToolTip="When on (default), a mugshot rendered with missing meshes/textures (or a detected FaceGen mismatch) shows the missing-asset warning icon, and that state is recorded in the PNG so the icon survives restarts. Unchecking hides the icon and re-renders the affected mugshots once so their recorded state is cleared. Note: while off, newly-rendered mugshots record no missing assets, so the 'Re-render When: Missing Assets' option has nothing to act on for them."

whenOnDefaultAMugshot4.original: When on (default), a mugshot whose outfit/headgear is missing meshes or textures — or references a physics config that doesn't exist (a broken SMP/HDT link inside the mod; the render itself is correct) — shows the outfit-assets warning icon, recorded in the PNG so it survives restarts. The missing meshes/textures re-render when you install the assets (via 'Re-render When: Missing Assets'); the broken physics link is informational. Unchecking hides the icon and re-renders the affected mugshots once so their recorded state is cleared.
whenOnDefaultAMugshot4.snippet: ToolTip="When on (default), a mugshot whose outfit/headgear is missing meshes or textures — or references a physics config that doesn't exist (a broken SMP/HDT link inside the mod; the render itself is correct) — shows the outfit-assets warning icon, recorded in the PNG so it survives restarts. The missing meshes/textures re-render when you install the assets (via 'Re-render When: Missing Assets'); the broken physics link is informational. Unchecking hides the icon and re-renders the affected mugshots once so their recorded state is cleared."

whenOnRenderThe.original: When on, render the NPC's default outfit in mugshots and the 3D preview. Body-covering armor hides the nude body underneath. On by default.
whenOnRenderThe.snippet: ToolTip="When on, render the NPC's default outfit in mugshots and the 3D preview. Body-covering armor hides the nude body underneath. On by default."

whenOnRenderWorn.original: When on, render worn/outfit head gear (helmets/hoods/circlets); hair is hidden under headgear, as in game. Off by default — the sensible choice for a face-picking tool.
whenOnRenderWorn.snippet: ToolTip="When on, render worn/outfit head gear (helmets/hoods/circlets); hair is hidden under headgear, as in game. Off by default — the sensible choice for a face-picking tool."

cameraVerticalFieldOf.original: Camera vertical field of view in degrees. Default is 25.
cameraVerticalFieldOf.snippet: ToolTip="Camera vertical field of view in degrees. Default is 25."

permanentlyDeletesAllAuto.original: Permanently deletes all auto-generated portrait images and cleans up empty folders. Detects mugshots from both the Internal and Legacy renderers via the "Parameters" PNG metadata chunk.
permanentlyDeletesAllAuto.snippet: ToolTip="Permanently deletes all auto-generated portrait images and cleans up empty folders. Detects mugshots from both the Internal and Legacy renderers via the "Parameters" PNG metadata chunk."

ifCheckedAllImages.original: If checked, all images will be cropped and resized to the most common dimensions for a uniform appearance. This may slightly increase load times.
ifCheckedAllImages.snippet: ToolTip="If checked, all images will be cropped and resized to the most common dimensions for a uniform appearance. This may slightly increase load times."

maxMugshotsToFit.original: Max # Mugshots To Fit On Screen:
maxMugshotsToFit.snippet: Text="Max # Mugshots To Fit On Screen:"

theMaximumNumberOf.original: The maximum number of mugshots to fit on-screen when auto-sizing. A lower number results in larger images.
theMaximumNumberOf.snippet: ToolTip="The maximum number of mugshots to fit on-screen when auto-sizing. A lower number results in larger images."

analyzeEachTileS.original: Analyze each tile's FaceGen NIF to show polycount / vertex / size info on the mugshot. First view of each FaceGen costs ~10ms; results are cached SHA-keyed across runs.
analyzeEachTileS.snippet: ToolTip="Analyze each tile's FaceGen NIF to show polycount / vertex / size info on the mugshot. First view of each FaceGen costs ~10ms; results are cached SHA-keyed across runs."

whenEnabledEachMugshot.original: When enabled, each mugshot's FaceGen NIF is parsed (or just stat'd for size-only) to surface authoring metrics. Useful for spotting absurdly heavy hair / head meshes.
whenEnabledEachMugshot.snippet: Text="When enabled, each mugshot's FaceGen NIF is parsed (or just stat'd for size-only) to surface authoring metrics. Useful for spotting absurdly heavy hair / head meshes."

triangleCountSummedAcross.original: Triangle count summed across all shapes in the FaceGen NIF.
triangleCountSummedAcross.snippet: ToolTip="Triangle count summed across all shapes in the FaceGen NIF."

vertexCountSummedAcross.original: Vertex count summed across all shapes.
vertexCountSummedAcross.snippet: ToolTip="Vertex count summed across all shapes."

textOverlayDrawsThe.original: Text Overlay draws the numbers directly on the mugshot. Tooltip shows a small dot — hover for the same info.
textOverlayDrawsThe.snippet: ToolTip="Text Overlay draws the numbers directly on the mugshot. Tooltip shows a small dot — hover for the same info."

topMarksTheHeaviest.original: Top % marks the heaviest N% of visible tiles per metric. Std Dev marks tiles whose value exceeds mean + N*stddev. Spectrum maps every tile along a Low→Mid→High gradient using min/max of visible tiles.
topMarksTheHeaviest.snippet: ToolTip="Top % marks the heaviest N% of visible tiles per metric. Std Dev marks tiles whose value exceeds mean + N*stddev. Spectrum maps every tile along a Low→Mid→High gradient using min/max of visible tiles."

forgetsEveryCachedFaceGen.original: Forgets every cached FaceGen stat. Next view of each tile will re-parse its NIF.
forgetsEveryCachedFaceGen.snippet: ToolTip="Forgets every cached FaceGen stat. Next view of each tile will re-parse its NIF."

showAColoredIndicator.original: Show a colored indicator on NPCs with saved selections. Green = has data, Purple = mugshot only, Red = not in load order.
showAColoredIndicator.snippet: ToolTip="Show a colored indicator on NPCs with saved selections. Green = has data, Purple = mugshot only, Red = not in load order."

automaticallyAdvanceToThe.original: Automatically advance to the next NPC in the list after selecting a mugshot.
automaticallyAdvanceToThe.snippet: ToolTip="Automatically advance to the next NPC in the list after selecting a mugshot."

ifYourLocalizedNPC.original: If your localized NPC names look garbled, try checking this box to enable the fix.
ifYourLocalizedNPC.snippet: ToolTip="If your localized NPC names look garbled, try checking this box to enable the fix."

donTShowMe.original: Don't show me popup warnings for actions with potential side effects

affectsMugshotsAndThe.original:
Affects mugshots and the 3D preview only — never the patch output. RaceMenu
                                            automatically recolors worn hair-slot items that use the Hair Tint shader,
                                            which the base game does not; wig meshes are usually authored with a
                                            near-black placeholder color that relies on it. With this on, wigs are
                                            previewed using the NPC's hair color, matching what you see in game with
                                            RaceMenu installed. Turn it off if you don't use RaceMenu — then the black
                                            hair shown here is what the game really renders.

theNormalMapsAs.original: The normal maps as loaded by the Nif model don't produce maximal brightness when illuminated directly, but rather at an angle. This seems physically incorrect, since things should generally look brightest when illuminated head-on. This hack explicitly rotates non-model-space normals to maximally illuminate in the direction of the incident light, making things like eyes and hair look brighter. I think this is more accurate than default, but you can disable this if you think the generated portraits have too much glare.
theNormalMapsAs.snippet: <TextBlock>The normal maps as loaded by the Nif model don't produce maximal brightness when illuminated directly, but rather at an angle. This seems physically incorrect, since things should generally look brightest when illuminated head-on. This hack explicitly rotates non-model-space normals to maximally illuminate in the direction of the incident light, making things like eyes and hair look brighter. I think this is more accurate than default, but you can disable this if you think the generated portraits have too much glare.</TextBlock>
